title: Route nodes by declared capability needs
narrative: Nubble starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Nubble prefers declaring what a step needs instead of hard-coding a model id, then picking among available classes. Accepts inspiration requirement 13. He walks product steps (route_capabilities) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario. [^insp-r13]
implementation: `route_for_capability_needs` in `mechaharness.routing` selects a model class from declared needs and available classes. `CliInstrumentor` verb `route_capabilities` exposes the host diagnostic.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `capability_route.yaml`: environment + graph + steps + complete expects.
